Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for non-small cell lung carcinoma. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (from drug_indication.efo_id), indication_label (from drug_indication.mesh_heading), and max_phase_for_ind. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading to 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' (or equivalent NSCLC heading). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
